verifiedFailurePaths.cause: AhaKeyAgent.sendState discarded SINGLE states while approvalRequestID was active; finishApproval did not replay them.
verifiedFailurePaths.fix: Keep the latest SINGLE state during an approval read; replay after release on a healthy channel. Clear pending state on mode suppression, connection reset, poison and shutdown. Preserve existing state-reset deadlines.

verifiedFailurePaths.cause: WS3TaskMetadata.enrich dropped identity when the entire Hook body exceeded 65536 bytes, preventing real tool input/output events from reaching MULTI registry and journal.
verifiedFailurePaths.fix: Decode only session identity with a 16 MiB input ceiling; retain existing session validation and avoid forwarding tool text.

reproduction.harness: Independent temporary Swift package linking real Shared/Agent sources and Agent tests, initially used because concurrent theme edits prevented the GUI target from compiling.
symptoms: Large Hook request has no task identity and cannot publish a live journal event.
Waiting state received during an approval read is never written after release.

validation.protocolRegression: Real Codex handler with 128 KiB input drives two independent MULTI slots and exact 0x99 running/waiting/running/done frames using synthetic firmware acknowledgements.
